answer: **结论：首次出现"装饰显著上升而形态同时下降"反向增长的时间是 CE -1700，即公元前 17 世纪。** 在该世纪点，Pottery Decoration 的 Z 值从 -0.48 跳升至 +0.97（ΔDeco = +1.45，显著上升），Pottery Form 的 Z 值从 +0.74 跌至 -1.13（ΔForm = -1.87，同时显著下降）。这是整个序列（CE -4100 至 -500，36 个可计算的世纪间变化）中唯一一次满足反向增长的事件，结论对阈值设定（0.05–0.5 Z 单位）、分位数定义（50/75/90 分位）、插值列（_inter）及 100 年滚动平滑全部稳健。capital.csv 中 BCE 4300/4200 两行回填重复行已被排除——扫描从 CE -4100 锚点开始、以世纪间差分进行，重复行不参与任何差分，故不会把首次反向出现误判得更早。

payload.hypothesis: The first century in which Diversity in Pottery Decoration rises significantly while Diversity in Pottery Form simultaneously declines is the 17th century BCE (CE = -1700): Decoration jumps from Z=-0.48 to Z=+0.97 (Δ=+1.45) while Form collapses from Z=+0.74 to Z=-1.13 (Δ=-1.87). This is the only reverse-growth event in the series (CE -4100 to -500) and is robust to all thresholds (0.05-0.5 Z units), quantile-based thresholds (50th-90th percentile), interpolated columns, and 100-year smoothing.
payload.workflow: 1) Loaded time_series_data.csv (3601 annual rows, CE -4100..-500); extracted the 37 century-resolution raw Z values for PotteryForm/PotteryDecoration. 2) Cross-validated against capital.csv: 37/39 rows match exactly under BCE=-CE; the BCE 4300 and 4200 rows are backfilled duplicates of CE -4100 and were excluded from chronological scanning. 3) Computed per-century deltas (dForm, dDeco); defined reverse growth as dDeco >= +thr AND dForm <= -thr; scanned chronologically from the CE -4100 anchor for the first occurrence. 4) Sensitivity: threshold sweep 0.05-0.5, quantile thresholds (50/75/90 pct of |dDeco|), _inter column century deltas, and 100-year rolling-mean smoothing — all yield CE -1700. Pollen openness data used only as background context.
